document.description: Lawful Permanent Resident status in Canada grants visa-free, simplified, or transit exemption privileges to multiple international jurisdictions.

unlocks.conditions: Valid, unexpired Canadian Permanent Resident Card + valid passport
unlocks.notes: Foreign nationals who have permanent resident status in Canada do not require a Mexican tourist visa for stays up to 180 days.

unlocks.conditions: Canadian Permanent Resident Card valid for at least 6 months
unlocks.notes: Holders of a Canadian Permanent Resident Card are exempt from consular entry visa requirements for tourism stays up to 30 days.

unlocks.conditions: Valid Canadian Permanent Resident Card presented upon arrival
unlocks.notes: Permanent residents of Canada may enter Belize without a prior visa or receive entry clearance on arrival for tourism up to 30 days.

unlocks.conditions: Valid Canadian Permanent Resident Card + valid travel document
unlocks.notes: Holders of valid permanent residence permits from Canada may enter Georgia without a visa for an aggregate stay of up to 90 days within any 180-day period.

unlocks.conditions: Valid, unexpired Canadian permanent residence permit
unlocks.notes: Foreign nationals who hold a valid permanent residence permit issued by Canada can enter Albania without a visa for up to 90 days within 180 days.
Holders of permanent residence permits in Canada may enter and stay in Montenegro without a visa for up to 30 days.

unlocks.conditions: Valid Canadian PR Card + valid passport
unlocks.notes: Any traveler with legal permanent residence in Canada may enter the Dominican Republic with a Tourist Card without requiring a consular visa.

unlocks.conditions: Canadian Permanent Resident Card valid for at least 6 months + passport
unlocks.notes: Executive Decree exempts holders of permanent residence in Canada from requiring a tourist visa for stays up to 30 days.

unlocks.conditions: In transit to or from Canada with confirmed onward flight within 30 days
unlocks.notes: Eligible nationals holding a Canadian Permanent Resident Card and transiting through South Korea directly to/from Canada are granted visa-free entry for up to 30 days.
